Carrefour Enters India Retail Market with Apparel Group

Carrefour, a global retail giant, has entered the Indian market through a partnership with the Apparel Group. The collaboration has resulted in the opening of a 50,000-square-foot flagship hypermarket in Greater Noida. This move signifies an ambitious entry into India's retail landscape.
